visual.name: Simple Waterfall Pro
visual.description: A simple waterfall allowing users to create multi step waterfall

fr-FR.Visual_Scale_by_width: Mettre à l'échelle selon la largeur

useSentimentFeatures.description: Use sentiments to define bar colors, label font colors and label positioning

limitBreakdownBy.description: How the steps that stay on the chart are chosen

maxBreakdown.description: Set the limit for number of steps

showStep.description: Keep this step on the chart whatever the ranking says. Steps are taken in the selected ranking order and Max steps still applies, so pinning more steps than it allows leaves the lowest-ranked of them in Other.

showUnknown.description: Add a step for the part of the closing balance the movements do not explain

useSentimentFeatures.displayName: Use Sentiment Features (hover mouse to see more)
useSentimentFeatures.description: Activate to use sentiments to define bar colors, label font colors and label positioning

sentimentColorTotal.description: The fill color for the Total

sentimentColorOther.description: The fill color for the other

fill.description: Colour of all bars. Supports conditional formatting from a measure.

barFill.description: Colour of one individual bar. Held apart from Bar colour so that a colour set for all bars cannot overwrite it.

labelRotation.description: Auto rotates labels only when a column is too narrow for them; Horizontal never rotates (wrap or ellipsis applies); Vertical always rotates.

barWidth.description: Enter a numeric value to specify the minimum bar width (min:10; max: 100)

padding.description: Enter a numeric value to specify the padding between the x-axis and x-axis laels (min:0; max: 20)

YAxisDataPointOption.description: Select how the starting point of the Y Axis is determined

enumeration.description: Base starting point is determined automatically
Set the axis bounds yourself. The actual bounds are rounded out to whole gridline steps.

YAxisDataPointRangeStart.description: Lower bound of the value axis. Leave empty to fit the data. Rounded out to a whole gridline step.

YAxisDataPointRangeEnd.description: Upper bound of the value axis. Leave empty to fit the data. Rounded out to a whole gridline step.

gridlineTransparency.description: Set gridline transparency (0% fully opaque, 100% fully transparent)

sentimentFontColorTotal.description: The Font color for the Total

negativeInBrackets.description: Show Negative value in brackets. Only works when you have selected 'Auto' as an option in 'Value Format' above

HideZeroBlankValues.description: Show or hide columns that have zero or blank values
